approved_release_video.observed_content: Synthetic Portfolio Demo identity and reserved example-domain email. Password masked throughout login. Native plate and demo diary/plan. No real photograph, visible token/invitation, personal data, foreign app, OS error/notification overlay or plaintext password observed. Android keyboard/status bar present.
approved_release_video.licence: Original application capture with application font/dependency/data notices; retain fake-analysis and synthetic-data context.

remaining_uncertainty: Legacy media/reference rights and privacy remain unreviewed and are excluded; filenames and historical reports do not establish safety.
Font bytes match previously recorded official upstream SHA-256 and complete OFL notices; upstream files were not fetched again.
Original Canvas/vector authorship rests on current repository source and original-code licensing, not an independent historical certification.
OCR is imperfect; every decoded frame state and all gallery images were additionally inspected visually. No issue was observed in the explicit allowlist.
